query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
           FROM mirror_records r
           WHERE r.epoch <= $2
             AND EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM mirror_record_legs l
                 WHERE l.record_id = r.record_id
                   AND l.source = ANY($1)
                   AND l.source NOT LIKE 'name:%'
                   AND l.family <> ALL($3::text[]))
